Samira (People Ops): :megaphone: Quick update — we've rolled out a short-term Emergency Travel Advance for caregivers and urgent family travel. Details and the request form below.

Priya (People Ops): TL;DR: up to $2,000 advance for flights and essential bookings, same-day approval for documented emergencies, and flexible repayment options.

Avi (Eng): Awesome — does this cover international travel and visa-expedite situations?

Samira (People Ops): Yes. It covers international emergency travel and urgent visa/medical situations. We created an expedited review queue — Finance aims for same-day approvals if the request and docs are submitted before 2pm PT.

Raj (Finance): FYI on the accounting side: advances <$2k will be coded to "Employee Emergency Travel" expense. Repayment options: payroll deduction, one-time card charge, or conversion to a non-repayable grant if approved by manager + People Ops.

Avi (Eng): Nice. Where's the form?

Priya (People Ops): Form: https://forms.redwood/example-emergency-travel — attach receipts or third-party confirmation (itinerary, hospital note, etc.) and one-line explanation. Put "emergency-advance" in the subject for faster routing.

Samira (People Ops): We're also piloting a backup-care credit for caregivers: $500/year stipend to help with last-minute childcare/eldercare (in-home or center). Eligibility and the enrollment link are in the doc.

Eli (People Ops): Quick offsite addendum: for company-sponsored offsites next quarter we now require a short Code-of-Conduct acknowledgement as part of travel preapproval. Please complete it when you submit your travel request.

Avi (Eng): Will the CoC acknowledgement be tied to expense submission?

Eli (People Ops): Yes — travel preapproval and expense submission will be blocked until the CoC acknowledgement is recorded for that trip. This only applies to company-sponsored or company-funded events.

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Offsite CoC ack due" will ping registered attendees 7 days and 2 days before travel.

Priya (People Ops): If you have a religious, medical, or accessibility accommodation that makes the standard acknowledgement problematic, DM People Ops and we'll provide an alternative path.

Samira (People Ops): We're hosting a short Q&A tomorrow at 11:00am PT in #people-ops-ama to walk through examples (international cases, repayment flows, backup-care enrolment). Bring questions.

Avi (Eng): If someone doesn't want to enroll in the backup-care pilot, can they opt out?

Priya (People Ops): It's opt-in. Enrollment is voluntary; pilot runs for 6 months and we'll evaluate usage/impact before any expansion.

Samira (People Ops): One last clarification: financial advances for planned vacation trips are unchanged — this program is strictly for time-sensitive family/emergency scenarios.

Raj (Finance): If anyone wants help filling the form or needs a private review before submitting, reply here and we'll assist.

Samira (People Ops): :pray: Thanks everyone — links and the full FAQ are in the doc linked above.
